feat(bluetooth_classic): migrate from flutter_bluetooth_serial to flutter_bluetooth_classic_serial

- Replace flutter_bluetooth_serial (^0.4.0) with flutter_bluetooth_classic_serial (^1.3.2)
- Rewrite ClassicBluetooth to use FlutterBluetoothClassic API
- Rewrite ClassicConnectedDevice with Stream-based data handling
- Update device discovery to use getPairedDevices()
- Remove setPin() method (deprecated - not supported by new library)
- Add proper resource cleanup with dispose() methods
- Improve connection state management with Streams

Breaking Changes:
- setPin() is now deprecated and throws UnsupportedError
- Devices must be paired through system Bluetooth settings
- Discovery only returns paired devices (via getPairedDevices)

Benefits:
- More modern Stream-based API
- Better state management
- Active maintenance (updated 3 months ago vs 2 years)
- Multi-platform support (Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows)
- Simpler connection management
